name: Daze Monster
text:
**Daze Monster**

**School** enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; **Level** arcanist 2, bard 2, bloodrager 2, medium 2, mesmerist 2, occultist 2, psychic 2, skald 2, sorcerer 2, summoner 1, summoner (unchained) 1, witch 2, wizard 2
**Casting Time** 1 standard action
**Components** V, S, M (a pinch of wool or similar substance)
**Range** medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
**Target** one living creature of 6 HD or less
**Duration** 1 round
**Saving Throw** Will negates; **Spell Resistance** yes

This spell functions like daze, but can affect any one living creature of any type. Creatures of 7 or more HD are not affected.
